business_problem: HelloTalk needed scalable AI services that could make language learning more immersive, accessible, and personalized for a globally distributed user base.
solution_summary: HelloTalk built key learning experiences on Azure AI so its app could support many languages and learning styles without forcing everyone into a rigid curriculum. The platform uses speech, voice, translation, and pronunciation services directly inside social learning experiences such as Voicerooms, live streams, Moments posts, course dialogues, and chat, which lets learners get contextual help while interacting with other people rather than leaving the conversation to look up language support elsewhere. Key components include Azure AI services, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, machine translation, and pronunciation assessment. HelloTalk gives learners a more effective and immersive experience, keeps the product accessible to a broad audience, and supports a truly global learning community without reducing the social nature of the platform.

solution_components.name: Azure AI services
solution_components.role: provides the umbrella AI capability that powers HelloTalk's learning features

solution_components.name: speech-to-text
solution_components.role: creates real-time transcription and subtitles in Voicerooms and live streams

solution_components.name: text-to-speech
solution_components.role: reads out content in Moments posts and chat to support comprehension

solution_components.name: machine translation
solution_components.role: helps learners understand conversations across languages

solution_components.name: pronunciation assessment
solution_components.role: gives learners feedback on speaking quality in posts and course dialogues

data_flow: Voice and text from Voicerooms, live streams, Moments posts, course dialogues, and chat are processed through speech-to-text, text-to-speech, translation, and pronunciation services, then returned to learners as subtitles, audio, meaning support, and speaking feedback inside the app experience.
business_outcome: HelloTalk gives learners a more effective and immersive experience, keeps the product accessible to a broad audience, and supports a truly global learning community without reducing the social nature of the platform.
architecture_clues: AI services are embedded into multiple in-app interaction surfaces rather than a separate assistant.
Real-time subtitles and pronunciation feedback are part of the runtime user flow.
evidence_quotes: Microsoft Azure's AI services play a key role in powering the features of HelloTalk.

These tools include real-time speech-to-text and subtitles in Voicerooms and live streams, text-to-speech in Moments posts and Chat, and pronunciation assessment in Moments posts and course dialogues.
With support for over 160 languages and users from over 200 countries, HelloTalk is a truly global platform.
